Jio Plans Space-Based Internet, Aims for 6G Rollout

Reliance Jio is planning to expand its network into space with a proposed constellation of approximately 1,600 low Earth orbit (LEO) satellites. The company is also reportedly positioning India to be among the first countries to roll out 6G technology.
